speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Morning prayer, brethren. I shall not keep you past the second glass.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The psalm is the psalm. I will not hang a new head upon it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Short, and cold, and he does not turn. That is the whole of him from this pew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is not speaking to me. I am not owed a word from that pew.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The book has the responses, Sir John. They do not want ornaments.

speaker: john_spencer
text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He will not add a greeting. He never does. Leave him his fur.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I came to stand the prayer. I did not come to be greeted.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The glass is through. I turn it once more, so I may see I have been long enough, and no longer.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: There. Twice. The prayer is said. I will not begin a new matter to fill a glass I have already turned.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are released. The close is wet. Dinner is across it, and I am going.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thank you, Master Thwaite. The glass was twice. That is the morning I came for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Amen is the end of it. He still has not looked this way.
